We need count of methyl groups in the molecule. But we don't have the molecule given. Possibly the sample is the one we have access to via NMR tools. We need to infer structure? Maybe the molecule is known from previous context? No context provided. We can request proton NMR or carbon NMR to deduce methyl groups. But we need the molecule identity. Could be a standard molecule used in tasks. Could be something like "acetophenone" etc. But we need to determine methyl count.

We can try to get proton NMR spectra (which will show methyl signals). Use proton_nmr_spectra tool. That will give a string of peaks. Then we can count methyl signals (singlet around 0.9 ppm etc). But need to know number of methyl groups, not just signals (could be overlapping). Could also use carbon NMR to see number of methyl carbons (around 10-30 ppm). Use carbon_nmr_spectra.

Let's first get proton NMR.
